license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 France (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
license.statement: Tatoeba text sentences default license per https://tatoeba.org/en/terms-of-use; attribution required: cite Tatoeba and the per-sentence author usernames.
license.attribution_string: Sentence data from Tatoeba (https://tatoeba.org), CC-BY 2.0 FR; authors: see per-note 'authors' fields and the aggregated username list in this manifest.

note_shape: 2-4 directly-linked ru-en sentence pairs, concatenated per side (parallel-concatenation unit, not narrative text); every Tatoeba sentence used at most once
selection_rule: deterministic, no RNG: pairs sorted by (ru_id,en_id); groups advanced in order; notes sorted by note key; first TARGET_NOTES kept

decontamination.method: n-gram 8-13 zero tolerance + verbatim hash, note-level and sentence-level
